verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own JavaScript integration, claimed 100% Segment-API compatible, plus a React integration (jitsu-docs-5, jitsu-docs-26). It also offers a Functions SDK/CLI workflow that scaffolds TypeScript projects with tests (jitsu-docs-49, jitsu-gh-6), so official client libraries exist for event tracking and function development. Beyond those, backend integration relies on a raw HTTP API and a Management API rather than language SDKs (jitsu-docs-2, jitsu-docs-47). missing for 10: server-side language SDKs (e.g. Node/Python/Go), an SDK wrapping the Management API, SDK reference documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
